notes.title: Controls 3 / First patch
notes.content:
Hi everyone, I have released the first patch for the game. This patch covers some basic movement fixes and tool tips added to the game for an enhanced experience.

Added:

-Tool tips to help players play through the game and understand the controls better

-Fixed a bug related to the Despina terrain

-Basic movement fixes

-Added some\ collision detection to some parts of the map (such as trees and some rocks) and still working on some more.

-Fixed a bug when the player would open the controls menu, it would crash the game if they were using an AMD graphics card.


Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Controls Part 2
notes.content: Hi everyone. I think I've figured a small patch for the movement system. Also I'm working on some bug fixes and adding tool tips to guide you through the game. You can expect the patch within 10 days. Thanks for sticking with me.

notes.title: Controls.
notes.content: Hey everybody. I've been getting some complaints about the way the player is controlled, the player's movement feels "clunky" and slow. Currently, I'm trying to modify the way it is controlled but this is proving to be quite difficult because of the way the asset is set up. I am working on a patch, but it could take some time. Thanks for being patient with me.
